subject.title: [Feature]: Standardize skill data directory convention (configPaths) under ~/.openclaw/

question: Should OpenClaw define a first-class per-skill runtime data contract, and should that contract be a filesystem convention, a plugin/SQLite API, or ClawHub authoring guidance only?
rationale: Current main does not implement the requested contract, and adding one would create durable storage and metadata behavior that affects skill authors, backups, sandboxing, and compatibility.

options.title: Design a generic data contract first
options.body: Define a narrow OpenClaw-owned skill/plugin data contract before adding metadata parsing, install-time directory creation, docs, or migrations.

options.title: Adopt a filesystem convention
options.body: Standardize a path such as ~/.openclaw/data/skills/<slug> and document the security, backup, and migration expectations for skill authors.

options.title: Keep this as ClawHub guidance
options.body: Do not add core runtime behavior yet; instead ask ClawHub skill authors to avoid home-root directories and publish convention docs.

recommendation.title: Design a generic data contract first
recommendation.body: Define a narrow OpenClaw-owned skill/plugin data contract before adding metadata parsing, install-time directory creation, docs, or migrations.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent docs/source history and VISION.md make steipete the strongest routing candidate for the product/storage-boundary choice.
